definition.quantity: unweighted h1^q, not x*h1 or a TMD
definition.antiquarks: zero in the historical initial family; no subtraction ambiguity
definition.endpoint_policy: Integrate only the measured-x window; no full-x extrapolation

numerical_policy.refinement_rule: Evaluate the first three resolutions of each ladder. Extend within the frozen budget while its last pair fails or the independent cross comparison fails. No threshold changes.
numerical_policy.native_grid: single grid at literal xmin=0.0065; dy=-log(xmin)/intervals; include endpoint 1
numerical_policy.dense_grid: independent log/sqrt background plus locked input knots, clipped to xmin and augmented by both integration bounds
numerical_policy.moment_integration: exact integral of the piecewise-linear interpolant in x; clip first/last cells to the requested bounds
numerical_policy.independent_integration: QuadGK of the dense evolved interpolant in log(x), split at every grid knot; dx=x*dlog(x)

printed_value_policy.criterion: Each moment at the literal rounded Table 1 center must differ from its printed paper center by at most half a last printed digit. This check is separate from numerical convergence.

parameter_rounding.role: diagnostic only; cannot rescue any failed center or numerical check
parameter_rounding.domain_clipping: Intersect Nh intervals with [-1,1]; no optimizer-bound state was recovered
parameter_rounding.method: Evaluate all 64 vertices of the six-dimensional printing box using the final native moment functional; include the center separately
parameter_rounding.limitation: Vertex ranges are sampled sensitivity ranges, not certified extrema over the continuous box or recovered fit uncertainties

status_policy: PASS only if every numerical and raw-center check passes; missing or failed checks remain FAIL. No production readiness artifact is created.
limitations: Printed Table 1 centers are rounded; exact historical optimizer states and original KPSY/modified-HOPPET code remain unlocated
The reference uses an independent evolution discretization and initial formula but shares the locked physical input sources
This checks two collinear partial moments only; it does not reproduce SIDIS/SIA/STAR observables, historical chi2, covariance, uncertainty coverage, full twist-3 evolution or a new extraction
Final tensor-charge reporting at Q=2 GeV is a separate future product; this paper benchmark is at Q2=10 GeV2
Production readiness and G2PERF remain false; synthetic closure cannot replace this check
